result:
All ten demos are rebuilt from today's apps and kit and committed in Orbit-Showcase. The screenshot font fix is in Orbit-Core. Showcase `npm test` passes (24 tests, 23 pass, 1 skipped, 0 fail). Orbit-Core `npm test` passes (1486 pass, 0 fail). I couldn't retake any screenshots or run the workflows here.

## 1) Stale demos

**What went stale and why:** nothing ever committed what the daily deploy recorded.
- The deploy (`.github/workflows/deploy.yml`, cron `17 2 * * *`, 10:17 Taipei) recorded and built the demos inside the runner and published them. Its permission was `contents: read` and it had no commit step, so `public/demo/` in git only changed when someone re-recorded by hand.
- The fallback then kept that committed copy silently. A demo that failed to record, or any run outside 08:00–22:00 Taipei, published the old copy, and the failure only showed as a `::warning::`.
- The family repos and Orbit-Core are cloned fresh from the default branch on every run, so I found no version pin or cache there. `build.mjs` also rebuilds the kit copy from Orbit-Core's main each time.
- The Transit and Securities demos from 3 and 10 Nov were already re-recorded in the latest commit (`b8e7a08`). This run was a refresh, not a change from very old copies (mostly 1–76 files per app). Some of Jay's old bugs may therefore not be in the demo files. They could be in the tour steps or the frame, and I didn't check those.

**What I changed in `scripts/demo` and `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`:**
- The deploy now has `contents: write` and commits `public/demo` and `public/data` back to main, before the minify step. It rebases and retries the push.
- The demos step is now `continue-on-error`, and `refresh.mjs` exits 1 if any demo fails to record. The deploy still publishes, then a final step turns the run red.
- `refresh.mjs --force` skips the 08:00–22:00 window, for one-off runs.
- `build.mjs` writes `public/demo/_demo/built.json` with the app commit, kit commit and time for each demo. A new test, `tests/demo-fresh.test.mjs`, checks all ten are present.
- I updated `MAP.md` to match.

**The build here:** all ten apps recorded (Sports needed its retry), then I built them from every repo's current `main` (kit `50ff059`). I also rebuilt once more after the font change below.

**Gaps:**
- The sandbox did reach `orbit.jaypengx.com`, so Sports' `nba-elta.json` was fetched fresh.
- A few third-party URLs failed while recording, as in normal runs. Examples are thesportsdb, nba.com logos, and one OSM routing call and one CBC picture.
- The live-data demos (Sports, Securities, Law, Transit, News) are frozen as of now, around 00:30 Taipei, outside market hours. The daily deploy replaces them at 10:17.
- Nothing is pushed. The first daily run with the new commit step will show whether the token can push to main. I couldn't test that here.

## 2) Chinese font

**What was wrong:** the kit's stack names `PingFang TC` and `Noto Sans TC`. Neither is installed on Linux, where the Debian package `fonts-noto-cjk` provides `Noto Sans CJK TC`. The text fell through to generic `sans-serif`, which fontconfig resolves to the first CJK font it has. That is Noto Sans CJK JP (Japanese glyph forms) or nothing at all (boxes). The sandbox had no CJK font, and `fc-match "PingFang TC"` returned DejaVu. After I installed `fonts-noto-cjk`, `sans-serif:lang=ja` resolved to the JP font.

**What I changed in Orbit-Core and Showcase:**
- **New `tools/fonts.mjs`:** `chineseFonts()` writes a user fontconfig file so `PingFang TC`, `Noto Sans TC` and `zh-tw` text all resolve to Noto Sans CJK TC. It warns when the font isn't installed. I checked with `fc-match` that this works with the font installed.
- **Where it's called:** `preview.mjs`, `shots.mjs`, `help-shots.mjs`, `store-shots.mjs`, `live-scroll.mjs`, `brand/generate.mjs`, and the Showcase's `record.mjs`.
- **Font stacks:** `Noto Sans CJK TC` was added to the stacks in `kit/orbit.css`, `brand/`, `store-shots` and the Showcase home page. The kit's `@font-face` now also lists `NotoSansCJKtc-Regular`.
- **Page language:** the brand share-card page in `brand/marks.mjs` now has `lang="zh-Hant"` (other pages already did). The browser locale was already `zh-TW`.
- **Workflows:** the Showcase deploy and Orbit-Core `agent.yml` now `apt-get install fonts-noto-cjk`.
- **Docs:** `tools/README.md` explains the cause.

The Showcase screenshots will look right only once another run retakes them with the font installed. I didn't run `shots.mjs`, `layout-check` or `push.sh` here.

Commits are `3dcc247` and one font commit in Orbit-Showcase, and `35b8cb3` in Orbit-Core.
